ayahOccurrences.text: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: nominative masculine indefinite (form VIII) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُّقْتَحِمٌ is in the derivative form: مُقْتَحِم
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/ح/م q–ḥ–m to rush, to plunge, to burst into, to embark boldly; hardship; to scorn; to pass over; to be aged.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
اِقْتَحَمَ ʾiqtaḥama and مُقْتَحِم muqtaḥim.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُقْتَحِم muqtaḥim [act. part.] one who is rushing in headlong

(38:59) هَذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ this is a group rushing in headlong with you.

entries.label: اِقْتَحَمَ
entries.definitionHtml:
اِقْتَحَمَ ʾiqtaḥama [v. VIII, trans.] to take on, to set upon, to fall upon, to assault

(90:11) فَلاَ اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ will he not attempt the steep path?
